main_body: A lamp-post style column: a domed grey cap with a gold ornament on top, a lit lantern box, a thin 2px pole, and a domed base. The cap is the largest volume.
top_band: Light grey (#97a1a2, L~150-158) on rows 1-4 at x=4 and x=8, over a mid grey (L~122) dome face on rows 4-7. At x=11 the cap is one tone (L=122) for rows 1-7.
evidence: The cap reads as a rounded disc wider than the shaft, with a lighter top of about 4 rows (step of 26-36 L to the dome face) and darker rows 8-10 beneath it. That is a marginal ellipse cap and not a flat band. The same dome-with-highlight construction repeats on the base. The pole is only 2px wide, and the lantern block is flat-painted. The top is weakly separated from the face in the centre column, so the pass is marginal.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 12 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and 12 colours per tile against 17-20. The grey ramp has about 5 steps, but the pole, the lantern frame and the lower dome are large flat areas with no grain, speckle or per-part highlights. 45% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is partly near-black and the piece looks sticker-like next to the tinted-outline references. It is thinner and flatter than the stall and the well.
